scope: Offline static analysis only; no APK execution, vehicle connection, or cloud request

v3_java_flow.persisted_copy: saveKeyInfo removes appEnc before serializing its SharedPreferences map
v3_java_flow.clear: clearKeyInfo removes the per-SN entry and sends updateSecret with an empty session_key_hex

v3_processor.prepare: Registers the SDK connection callback and stores the prepare timeout

on_process.id_1: Notifies prepare listeners that user interaction is pending
on_process.id_5: Notifies prepare listeners that interaction succeeded
on_process.id_6: Parses the callback message as a map and passes it to saveKeyInfo

v3_processor.on_success: Sets SDK state to CONNECTED and schedules timeout/read-version work
v3_processor.native_callback_id_semantics: Incomplete; Java switch branches do not recover the native protocol state machine

confirmed: V3 SecretInfo path requires SN and session_key_hex
Input check accepts 32 ASCII hex characters
A helper return is passed onward with explicit length 0x20
Credential dispatch uses indirect vtable slots at +0x20 and +0x48
One credential path uses service com.ninebot.blelibrary
unproven: The resulting bytes are the final AES key
SN is the keyring account or alias
The runtime vtable target and final BLE consumer

ble_rtp_native_followup.java_to_jni: BleSdkClient checks nonempty data and connected MAC, then passes the same byte[] to RustBridge.writeRtpData
ble_rtp_native_followup.jni: Copies bytes into Rust-owned storage and schedules an asynchronous future on LocalPool
unproven: RTP header removal, rewrite, or index insertion

coverage_limitations: REA's Windows JADX provider analyzes DEX but does not disassemble the ARM64 ELF native library
Native findings are focused offline disassembly; indirect dispatch and downstream consumers remain unresolved
No 2025-or-later vehicle was available for compatibility validation
